# 229. Majority Element II

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def majorityElement(self, nums):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :rtype: List[int]
        """
        return [k for k, v in collections.Counter(nums).items() if v > len(nums) // 3]
```
